run_visualization: run the visualization script to generate predicted vs ground truth face rendering images and videos
run_main: run the main function to load a trained model and visualize face reconstruction results on test segments
run_run_net: run the forward pass through the model to compute texture, vertex, and screen space losses
run_save_img: run the image saving function to export predicted, ground truth, and difference images with gamma correction
run_save_video: run the video generation function to compile GT, predicted, and diff frames into an AVI video
